# `fluxsim plugins`

List the vertical packs installed in this environment.

## Synopsis

```text
fluxsim plugins [options]
```

## Examples

```bash
# list the installed vertical packs
fluxsim plugins --json
```

## Options

| Option | Value | Description |
|---|---|---|
| `-j, --json` |  | emit machine-readable JSON |
